{"metadata":{"description":"Code knowledge graph plugin for agent harnesses (dsh): indexes symbols, call sites and imports into SQLite, answers call/dependency questions via CLI or stdio MCP tool server","id":"gh:1335842340","install_available":true,"language":"Python","name":"codegraph","slug":"JohnXu22786/codegraph","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Code knowledge graph plugin for agent harnesses (dsh): indexes symbols, call sites and imports into "},{"id":"p1s2","text":"SQLite, answers call/dependency questions via CLI or stdio MCP tool server"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"简体中文"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"# CodeGraph"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A code knowledge graph plugin: parses a codebase into a queryable index, so agents can answer struct"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ural questions like "who calls this function" or "what does this module depend on". Good for quickly"},{"id":"p4s3","text":" understanding large codebases, or as a risk-screening tool before making changes."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Self-contained implementation: Python standard library + SQLite, no mandatory third-party dependenci"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"es. Ships a CLI, a Python API, and a stdio tool server (MCP-style JSON-RPC 2.0) that any plugin-base"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"d harness can load as a subprocess."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Call graph**: `callers` / `callees` — who calls a given function/method, and what it calls
- **D"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ependency graph**: `deps` / `dependents` — what a module or file imports and who imports it (interna"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"l resolution vs. external dependencies)
- **Full-text search**: `search` — local full-text search ov"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"er symbol names, docstrings and signatures (SQLite FTS5, no external service)
- **Impact analysis**:"},{"id":"p7s5","text":" `impact` — transitive closure listing "who would be affected if this symbol changed"
- **Incrementa"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"l indexing**: content-hash comparison re-parses only changed files; deleted files are cleaned up aut"},{"id":"p7s7","text":"omatically
- **Visualization export**: `export dot|json` — Graphviz DOT / JSON, ready to drop into v"},{"id":"p7s8","text":"isualization tools
- **Query cache**: the tool server caches read-only queries with a 30-second TTL
"},{"id":"p7s9","text":"- **Two parse engines**: tree-sitter (precise, optional install) and a regex scanner (zero-dependenc"},{"id":"p7s10","text":"y fallback), chosen automatically"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Cross-file resolution is heuristic and tries, in priority order: exact match in the same file → file"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"s reachable by import → same package/module family → globally unique name. Call sites that fail to r"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"esolve keep their raw text and are marked `unresolved` (external code, standard library, third-party"},{"id":"p10s4","text":" their raw text and are marked `unresolved` (external code, standard library, third-party packages)."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Option B, without installing from the repo (run from the repository root):"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Windows Command Prompt:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Windows PowerShell:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Linux/macOS:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Requires Python ≥ 3.10. Supported languages: Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Go, Java, Rust."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Quick start"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Command line"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| Command | Description | Example |"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"| `init` | Write a starter `codegraph.json` config at the project root | `codegraph init` |
| `index"},{"id":"p25s2","text":" [--force]` | Build/refresh the index; `--force` re-parses everything | `codegraph index --force` |
"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"| `status` | Statistics: file/symbol/call/import counts, resolution rates, per-language breakdown | "},{"id":"p25s4","text":"`codegraph status` |
| `callers SYMBOL` | Direct callers | `codegraph callers pkg.cart.Cart.add` |
|"},{"id":"p25s5","text":" `callees SYMBOL` | Callees | `codegraph callees app.main` |
| `deps MODULE` | Module dependencies |"},{"id":"p25s6","text":" `codegraph deps web/index.ts` |
| `dependents MODULE` | Reverse dependencies | `codegraph dependent"},{"id":"p25s7","text":"s pkg.pricing` |
| `impact SYMBOL [--depth N]` | Transitive callers | `codegraph impact services.bil"},{"id":"p25s8","text":"ling.price --depth 3` |
| `search TEXT` | Full-text search | `codegraph search "shopping cart"` |
| "},{"id":"p25s9","text":"`export dot\|json [-o FILE]` | Export the graph | `codegraph export json -o g.json` |
| `serve` | St"},{"id":"p25s10","text":"art the stdio tool server | `codegraph serve` |"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Common options (before or after the subcommand): `--root` project root, `--config` config file, `--d"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"b` override database path, `--json` machine-readable output."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Tool interface (harness integration)"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"`codegraph serve` starts a stdio tool server: reads newline-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0 messages from std"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"in, writes responses to stdout, and sends all logs to stderr. It implements the handshake subset MCP"},{"id":"p28s3","text":" needs (`initialize`, `tools/list`, `tools/call`, `ping`) and works with any MCP client or harness t"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"hat speaks JSON-RPC directly."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"**8 tools** (full JSON Schemas are in `plugin.json`):"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"| Tool | Arguments | Returns |"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"| `callers` | symbol, limit | List of direct callers (symbol, file:line) |
| `callees` | symbol, lim"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"it | List of callees (with resolved/unresolved markers) |
| `deps` | module, limit | Dependency list"},{"id":"p31s3","text":" (with resolved file paths) |
| `dependents` | module, limit | Reverse dependency list |
| `search` "},{"id":"p31s4","text":"| query, limit | Symbols hit by full-text search |
| `impact` | symbol, depth, limit | Transitive ca"},{"id":"p31s5","text":"llers (with depth levels) |
| `overview` | — | Index statistics |
| `reindex` | force | Refresh the "},{"id":"p31s6","text":"index (the only writable tool) |"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"All tools except `reindex` are read-only and share a 30-second TTL query cache. When no index exists"},{"id":"p32s2","text":", read-only tools return an error with `isError: true`."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"Minimal conversation example:"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"## Installing in DSH"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"dsh (DeepSeek Harness, a plugin-based agent harness) loads this plugin through its built-in MCP clie"},{"id":"p36s2","text":"nt, with a single line of configuration:"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"Remove with:"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"See **docs/dsh-integration.md** for the full integration guide."},{"id":"p41s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p42s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p43s1","text":"`codegraph.json` (at the project root, generated by `codegraph init`; key fields shown below — `excl"},{"id":"p43s2","text":"ude` has 17 defaults, abbreviated here):"},{"id":"p44s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p45s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p46s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p47s1","text":"- The regex engine (`engine: quick`) is not string/comment aware: `foo(` inside a string can be reco"},{"id":"p47s2","text":"rded as a call site; signatures are single-line only
- The tree-sitter engine (`engine: deep`) does "},{"id":"p47s3","text":"not yet extract symbols for a few node shapes like arrow-function constants or object methods
- Cros"},{"id":"p47s4","text":"s-file call resolution is heuristic: same-name methods stay `unresolved` when not globally unique; d"},{"id":"p47s5","text":"ynamic calls (reflection, `getattr`, dynamic `import`) cannot be resolved
- Macro invocations (e.g. "},{"id":"p47s6","text":"`println!`) are not recorded as call sites
- These only affect precision in edge cases, never the co"},{"id":"p47s7","text":"re query path; index quality improves by installing tree-sitter grammar packages"}],"truncated":true}
